items.title: Frank Capp interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: a lot of guys that were with us at the very first album which was done in 1976 I think was Bill Green is still with us

ctx.x: Yeah, you can’t hold on to the personnel so much.

Yeah. And thanks be, for whatever reason, Juggernaut has always worked a lot for not being a traveling band, you know for not being a road band like the Basie band or Mercer Ellington, and all of the other ghost bands you know. But it’s not an easy job but we manage to keep most of the same musicians. We had Marshall Royal in our band right up until he died a few months ago, right from the very first album, and a lot of guys that were with us at the very first album which was done in 1976 I think was Bill Green…
Everybody’s got to make a living.
